trailhead.label: La Val church, by the tourist office and bus stop

waypoints.label: Fountain by La Val church (start and finish)

cautions: Asphalt village road with traffic at the start and finish.
About 400 m of narrow Cians access road shared with cars, each way.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
